name: qg-celue
title_zh: 三方需求拧成一股绳，行动清单当场落地
tagline_zh: 情感咨询最怕各说各话。它把ta的诉求、你的底线、关系现状拆开对齐，生成不偏袒任何一方的策略矩阵。
tagline_en: Stop the blame game. It aligns their needs, your boundaries, and the real situation into a fair strategy.
desc_en: 策略生成（KK 情感导师 SKII 体系）。从三方需求生成策略矩阵，并落地行动。
why_zh: 不靠感觉劝和，而是把三方需求做成可比较的矩阵，冲突点自动显形，策略从结构里长出来，不是拍脑袋。
why_en: No vague advice. It structures all three perspectives into a matrix, exposing conflicts mechanically—so strategies emerge from.
limit_zh: 只处理情感关系类策略，不涉及法律/财务裁决；需要你输入至少两方明确诉求，否则矩阵缺列、输出会偏向单一视角。
limit_en: Only for relationship strategy—no legal/financial rulings. Needs explicit input from ≥2 parties or the matrix skews. Outputs advice only; no sending.
title_en: Turn 3-way needs into one action plan
